Canada Deports Record 3,323 Indians in Early 2026

Canada deported a record 3,323 Indian nationals in the first half of 2026. The deportations were primarily due to non-compliance with immigration rules, rejected asylum or refugee claims, visa overstays, and visa fraud scams. This figure represents a significant increase, marking a record number of deportations for the period.
